create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ and __call__ methods for a custom model
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand the required interface for subclasses
summarize_pipeline_interface: summarize the Pipeline ABC interface including model_id initialization and callable inputs
build_custom_pipeline: build a concrete Pipeline subclass that processes inputs using a specified model_id
test_pipeline_exception: test that PipelineException is raised and caught correctly in pipeline error handling
